# Nova Nutrition

> Nova Nutrition makes sports supplements for bodybuilders and serious gym-goers: whey protein, mass gainer and creatine monohydrate. Every ingredient and amount is printed on the tub, with no proprietary blends. Nova supplies gyms, supplement stores and online shops.

Website: https://novanutritionlabs.com/
Last updated: 2026-11-23

## Products

### Nova Whey Protein
- Flavour: Double Chocolate
- Serving: 30 g (1 scoop)
- Per serving: 25 g protein, 5.5 g BCAAs (naturally occurring), 120 kcal, 3 g carbohydrates, 1.5 g sugar, 1.8 g fat
- Use: after training, mixed in water or milk
- Sizes: 1 kg (33 servings), 2.27 kg / 5 lb (75 servings), 4.5 kg / 10 lb (150 servings)

### Nova Mass Gainer
- Flavour: Vanilla Ice Cream
- Serving: 250 g (5 scoops)
- Per serving: 1000 kcal, 50 g protein (whey and casein blend), 180 g carbohydrates, 3 g creatine monohydrate, 14 g sugar, 6 g fat
- For: hard gainers who struggle to eat enough calories to grow
- Sizes: 3 kg (12 servings), 5 kg (20 servings), 7 kg (28 servings)

### Nova Creatine Monohydrate
- Flavour: Unflavoured
- Serving: 5 g (1 scoop), once a day
- Per serving: 5 g micronised creatine monohydrate, 0 kcal, no additives
- Use: mix into water, juice or a protein shake
- Sizes: 300 g (60 servings), 500 g (100 servings), 1 kg (200 servings)

## Wholesale and distributors

Gyms, supplement stores and online shops can stock Nova Nutrition. Send a request through the distributor form and the team replies with wholesale prices and terms.
